pressure_hypothesis.title: A known campaign session cannot be selected when project continuations conflict
pressure_hypothesis.basis: one live read reproduction plus the selected-session adapter contract
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Provide an exact-session continuation selector for a caller that already knows the session identity. Control must still validate the authenticated principal, campaign, Environment definition, workspace, checkout identity, lifecycle, and claim authority before selecting it.
not_measured: time or token cost of the failed read
whether each lifecycle-active candidate still has a live agent process
why the duplicate continuations were created

supporting_sources.observed_contract: session_id must already equal context.selected_session_id; project continuation selectors contain campaign_id and task_identity only
